about: Proxy decks people share on r/mpcproxies and Ko-fi. Free ones can be browsed and printed straight away; paid ones link to their Ko-fi page – after buying, add the download link you got and they show here too. Every deck keeps its maker's credit.

decks.title: Shadow of the Colossus – Basic Edition (free version)
decks.creator: White Rabbit MTG
decks.notes: The free version, at a lower resolution. The full-resolution files and White Rabbit's other decks are on their Ko-fi (most need a purchase or a membership). The cards are real Magic cards with new art and frames, and the deck comes with its decklist.
